meta.promptText: India mein women ke liye online konse brand ke kurta sets kharidun?

response.text:
Bilkul! 😊 Agar India mein **online women’s kurta sets** lene hain, toh main in brands ko recommend karunga:

| Brand | Best for | Approx. budget |
|---|---|---:|
| **Biba** | Elegant, reliable everyday + festive | ₹1,200–₹4,000 |
| **W for Woman** | Office wear, polished look | ₹1,000–₹4,000 |
| **Aurelia** | Stylish daily/occasion wear | ₹700–₹3,000 |
| **Libas** | Trendy + budget-friendly | ₹600–₹2,500 |
| **Fabindia** | Cotton, classy & timeless | ₹1,500–₹5,000+ |
| **Rangriti** | Colourful, affordable daily wear | ₹500–₹2,000 |
| **Janasya** | Pretty prints + cotton sets | ₹800–₹1,800 |


Recent comparisons particularly rate **W** for polished/office looks, **Biba** for practical cotton everyday wear, **Fabindia** for timeless handcrafted styles, and **Aurelia** for dressier occasions. [www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/i-tried-kurta-sets-from-w-fabindia-aurelia-biba-and-lakshita-here-s-which-ones-actually-feel-worth-the-money-101778651587378-amp.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Mere top picks 👇

**💗 Everyday / college / casual:** Libas or Aurelia  
**💼 Office:** W for Woman  
**🌸 Elegant & feminine:** Biba  
**🌿 Cotton & premium feel:** Fabindia  
**🎉 Function / festive:** Biba or Aurelia  
**💰 Under ₹1,500:** Libas / Rangriti / Janasya
